title: A row outside the reader's scope answers 404
why: Scoped reads and roles without a read grant no longer confirm which ids exist. A client that treated 403 as 'exists but forbidden' sees 404.
changelog: `GET /api/<r>/<id>` of a row outside the reader's scope
steps: Treat 404 and 403 from by-id reads as 'not available'; do not infer that the row exists.
